newsitem.title: USA: Ryan, Beck & Co names Neff chairman.
newsitem.headline: Ryan, Beck & Co names Neff chairman.

text.p: Ryan Beck & Co Inc said on Thursday that it named Richard Neff chairman, replacing Fenwick Garvey who has resigned.
The company said Garvey resigned to spend more time with his family. He retains his position in Ryan, Beck's equities trading department.

Neff, 48, is executive vice president and chief financial officer of DiGiorgio Corp, a wholesale food distributor, and also is president and chief executive officer of Las Plumas Lumber Co LLC. He has been on Ryan Beck's board since 1994.
Ryan, Beck is a financial services company.
